const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Recorded visual pick-and-place controller for the RoboWits standard episode.
+
+The script uses only the RGB-D observation, proprioception, and the documented
+stateless IK endpoint. It fits the ball from its visible depth samples, finds
+the tower axis from the visible post, then grasps the ball and releases it on
+the top orange ring.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+RUN = OUT / "gen_run"
+RUN.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+DT = 0.1
+VERTICAL_DOWN = np.array([0.0, 0.70710678, 0.70710678, 0.0])
+
+
+def deproject_pixels(obs, camera, us, vs, zs):
+    """Return world points for OpenCV pixels and their measured z-depth."""
+    cam = obs.meta["cameras"][camera]
+    k = np.asarray(cam["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    ext = np.asarray(cam["extrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    pc = (np.linalg.inv(k) @ np.stack((us, vs, np.ones_like(us)), axis=0)) * zs
+    return (ext[:, :3].T @ (pc - ext[:, 3:4])).T
+
+
+def save_observation(obs, name):
+    for camera, frame in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(RUN / f"{name}_{camera}.png")
+    for camera, depth in obs.last_depth.items():
+        np.save(RUN / f"{name}_{camera}_depth.npy", depth)
+
+
+def fit_scene(obs):
+    """Estimate the ball centre/radius and visible tower axis from RGB-D."""
+    rgb = obs.last["ego"].astype(np.int16)
+    depth = obs.last_depth["ego"]
+
+    # Yellow ball appearance in this calibrated scene; the ROI excludes the
+    # red rings. Color removes the white tabletop before fitting the sphere.
+    ball_rgb = rgb[310:345, 415:455]
+    ball_mask = (
+        (ball_rgb[:, :, 0] > ball_rgb[:, :, 1] * 1.04)
+        & (ball_rgb[:, :, 0] < ball_rgb[:, :, 1] * 1.50)
+        & (ball_rgb[:, :, 1] > ball_rgb[:, :, 2] * 1.8)
+        & (ball_rgb[:, :, 2] < 50)
+        & (ball_rgb[:, :, 0] < 200)
+    )
+    by, bx = np.where(ball_mask)
+    bu, bv = bx + 415, by + 310
+    bz = depth[bv, bu]
+    valid = (bz > 0.60) & (bz < 0.75)
+    bu, bv, bz = bu[valid], bv[valid], bz[valid]
+    if len(bu) < 40:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"ball RGB-D mask too small: {len(bu)} points")
+    ball_points = deproject_pixels(obs, "ego", bu, bv, bz)
+    # Algebraic least-squares sphere fit to the visible surface patch.
+    mat = np.column_stack((2 * ball_points, np.ones(len(ball_points))))
+    rhs = np.sum(ball_points * ball_points, axis=1)
+    fit = np.linalg.lstsq(mat, rhs, rcond=None)[0]
+    ball_center = fit[:3]
+    ball_radius = float(np.sqrt(fit[3] + ball_center @ ball_center))
+    residual = np.abs(np.linalg.norm(ball_points - ball_center, axis=1) - ball_radius)
+    inliers = residual < 0.001
